idiom-31-q51.truthCondition: Two clinic coordinators argue fiercely whenever they divide the afternoon appointments.
idiom-31-q51.correctReason: 正確句保留兩名診所協調員每次分配下午預約都會激烈爭執，沒有把爭議改成病人的病情。

foils.text: The two clinic coordinators fight like cat and dog whenever they divide the morning appointments.
foils.reason: 「morning」把爭議時段由下午預約改成早上預約。

foils.text: The two clinic coordinators fought like cat and dog only once when dividing the afternoon appointments.
foils.reason: 「only once」把每次分配都會吵改成只吵過一次。

foils.text: The two clinic coordinators calmly agree whenever they divide the afternoon appointments.
foils.reason: 「calmly agree」把激烈爭執改成平靜達成共識。

idiom-31-q52.truthCondition: The leaders of two recycling groups have argued angrily at every planning meeting for months.
idiom-31-q52.correctReason: 正確句保留不同回收團體的兩名負責人、數月時間及籌備會議中的反覆爭吵。

foils.text: The two recycling-group leaders fought like cat and dog at one planning meeting months ago.
foils.reason: 「one ... months ago」把數月來每次會議都吵改成數月前的一次會議。

foils.text: The two recycling-group leaders have been fighting like cat and dog at public collection points for months.
foils.reason: 「public collection points」把爭吵地點由籌備會議改成收集點。

foils.text: The two recycling-group leaders have been agreeing calmly at every planning meeting for months.
foils.reason: 「agreeing calmly」把每次籌備會議中的激烈爭吵改成平靜同意。

idiom-31-q53.truthCondition: Two app designers repeatedly shout at each other over the login flow rather than settle a plan.
idiom-31-q53.correctReason: 正確句把慣用語用在反覆激烈爭執，並保留登入流程的分歧與遲遲未能定案。

foils.text: The two app designers fight like cat and dog over the colour scheme instead of settling a plan.
foils.reason: 「colour scheme」把爭議由登入流程改成配色。

foils.text: The two app designers fight like cat and dog over the login flow but soon settle on a plan.
foils.reason: 「soon settle on a plan」說兩人很快定案；原題說兩人爭吵而遲遲未能定案。

foils.text: The two app designers discuss the login flow quietly without shouting instead of settling a plan.
foils.reason: 「quietly without shouting」把反覆互相叫罵改成安靜討論，也沒有用上目標慣用語。

idiom-31-q54.truthCondition: Two gallery curators agree on the exhibition theme but quarrel bitterly over each artwork selection.
idiom-31-q54.correctReason: 正確句保留策展人同意整體主題，卻為每件作品的選擇激烈爭執的反差。

foils.text: The gallery curators fight like cat and dog over each artwork because they disagree on the exhibition theme.
foils.reason: 「disagree on the exhibition theme」否定了原題說兩人同意主題。

foils.text: The gallery curators fight like cat and dog over one artwork, although they agree on the theme.
foils.reason: 「one artwork」把每件作品都吵縮成只為一件作品爭吵。

foils.text: The gallery curators agree on the theme and calmly select each artwork together.
foils.reason: 「calmly select」把每件作品的激烈爭吵改成和平選擇。

idiom-31-q55.truthCondition: During last year's ferry project, two route planners argued fiercely at almost every meeting.
idiom-31-q55.correctReason: 正確句保留去年渡輪項目、兩名路線規劃員，以及幾乎每次會議都激烈爭吵。

foils.text: The two route planners fight like cat and dog at almost every meeting on this year's ferry project.
foils.reason: 「this year's」把原題的去年項目改成今年項目。

foils.text: The two route planners fought like cat and dog at almost every meeting on last year's rail project.
foils.reason: 「rail project」把渡輪項目改成鐵路項目。

foils.text: The two route planners rarely argued during meetings on last year's ferry project.
foils.reason: 「rarely」把幾乎每次會議都吵改成很少爭吵。
